تعضون (form I)
# تَعَضُّونَ (taʕaḍḍūna) /ta.ʕadˤ.dˤuː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of عَضَّ (ʕaḍḍa)
# تُعَضُّونَ (tuʕaḍḍūna) /tu.ʕadˤ.dˤuː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of عَضَّ (ʕaḍḍa)
